description.en: Nebraska is a landlocked state in the Great Plains and Midwestern region of the United States. It borders South Dakota to the north; Wyoming to the west; Colorado to the southwest; Kansas to the south; and Missouri to the southeast and Iowa to the east, both across the Missouri River.
description.zh-CN: 內布拉斯加州是美國中西部大平原区的一州，它的名稱來自美國原住民中的吉韋雷語，意為平順之水。該州有普拉特河貫穿整州。
description.zh-TW: 內布拉斯加州是美國中西部大平原區的一州，它的名稱來自美國原住民中的吉韋雷語，意為平順之水。該州有普拉特河貫穿整州。
